summary_en: Sodick established a buyback program to acquire up to 2.4 million shares (4.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of JPY 3.0 billion via open market purchases from October 22 to December 23, 2026.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Concerning Share Buyback (Treasury Stock Acquisition Based on Articles of Incorporation under Company Law Article 459(1))
translation_en_brief: Sodick Co., Ltd. determined the acquisition period for its share buyback program on October 14, 2026. The company will acquire up to 2.4 million shares (4.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 3.0 billion through open market purchases from October 22 through December 23, 2026. The acquisition period was finalized following the determination of the offering price for the company's concurrent equity offering, which was decided on the same date. The buyback will be executed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange via market purchase method. Market conditions may result in partial or non-execution of the acquisition program.
